'
t Schulten Hues
was a
restaurant
in
Zutphen
,
Netherlands
. It was a
fine dining restaurant
that was awarded one
Michelin star
for the period 2005–2018.

Head chef
of
'
t Schulten Hues
is Peter Gast.
[
8
]
Gast and his wife  Jacqueline van Liere opened the restaurant in September 2002.
[
9
]
Originally, the restaurant was located on the Houtmarkt, but moved to a bigger location at 's-Gravenhof in 2007.
[
10
]
[
11
]
Book
In 2010,
'
t Schulten Hues
presented a book named "Portfolio XL" in a rather exceptional size: 0.5 meter x 0.7 meter.
[
12
]
The restaurant closed on July 1, 2018, because the owners wanted to take on a new challenge in Amsterdam.
